vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: invoice-recognition
Version: 1.0.2

The invoice-recognition skill bundle is a legitimate tool for OCR and structured data extraction from various invoice types. The Python script (scripts/pdf_to_image.py) uses standard libraries (pdf2image, Pillow) to handle file conversions as described, and the SKILL.md instructions provide clear, non-malicious guidance for the AI agent to process documents and validate financial logic without any evidence of data exfiltration, unauthorized execution, or prompt injection attacks.

llm.summary: Skill's code, instructions, and requirements are coherent for an invoice OCR/validation utility and do not request unrelated credentials or unusual system privileges.

dimensions.detail: Name and description (invoice OCR, type classification, field extraction, format/logic validation) match the included files: a PDF->image conversion script plus detailed format/reference docs. Declared Python dependencies (pdf2image, Pillow) are appropriate for PDF->image conversion.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md keeps scope to receiving files, converting PDF/OFD to images, using the agent's image-recognition (OCR) to extract fields, and validating formats. One small ambiguity: it relies on the agent's "原生图像识别能力" (native image recognition) for OCR — depending on the agent runtime this may imply local OCR or calls to a remote model/API; users should confirm how image data is processed in their deployment if privacy is a concern.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No automated install spec; the SKILL.md instructs pip install of well-known libraries (pdf2image, Pillow) and optional ofd2pdf. No downloads from arbitrary URLs or archive extraction. Note: pdf2image requires the system poppler-utils binary; that system dependency is documented in the script header.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: No environment variables, credentials, or external endpoints are requested. The skill does not declare or attempt to access unrelated credentials or config paths.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false, the skill is user-invocable and does not request persistent elevated privileges or modify other skills. It only writes/reads files that the agent is instructed to handle (PDF->image conversion outputs).
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears internally consistent for converting PDFs/OFD to images and guiding OCR-based invoice extraction. Before installing: (1) confirm where image/OCR processing happens (locally vs remote API) because invoices contain sensitive personal/company data; (2) ensure poppler-utils is installed on the host for pdf2image to work; (3) if you need OFD support, install ofd2pdf as documented; (4) be aware the conversion script writes output image files to disk — delete originals/output if you require stronger privacy; (5) verify the agent/runtime's data-handling policy (logs, telemetry, remote inference) if you must keep invoice data confidential.
